functions.name: nghttp2_rcbuf_incref
functions.description: Increment the reference count of the reference-counted buffer rcbuf by 1. Use when sharing the buffer across owners.
requirements: rcbuf must be a valid pointer obtained from nghttp2 and not previously freed.
After incref, caller must later balance with nghttp2_rcbuf_decref to avoid leaks.

functions.name: nghttp2_rcbuf_decref
functions.description: Decrement the reference count of rcbuf by 1. Frees the underlying object when the count reaches zero; rcbuf must not be used after it is freed.
requirements: rcbuf must be a valid pointer previously incref’d or returned by nghttp2 (not already fully released).
After this call reduces refcount to zero, the object is freed and must not be used.

functions.name: nghttp2_rcbuf_get_buf
functions.description: Return the underlying contiguous buffer (base pointer and length) managed by rcbuf.
requirements: rcbuf must be valid and alive (i.e., not freed).
The returned nghttp2_vec is a copy of pointer/length; do not free base via standard free; lifetime is tied to rcbuf.

functions.name: nghttp2_rcbuf_is_static
functions.description: Return nonzero if rcbuf’s buffer is statically allocated (useful to avoid unnecessary copies in bindings).
requirements: rcbuf must be a valid pointer.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_new
functions.description: Allocate and initialize an nghttp2_session_callbacks object with all callbacks set to NULL. Use to configure callbacks before creating sessions.
requirements: callbacks_ptr must be a non-NULL pointer to receive the allocated object.
Returns 0 on success or NGHTTP2_ERR_NOMEM on OOM; caller must check return value.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_del
functions.description: Free resources associated with a callbacks object. No-op if callbacks is NULL.
requirements: callbacks must either be NULL or a pointer previously returned by nghttp2_session_callbacks_new().
Do not use callbacks after deletion.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_send_callback
functions.description: Set deprecated send callback (nghttp2_send_callback) on a callbacks object. Prefer the v2 variant. Used when using nghttp2_session_send() without mem_send().
requirements: cbs must be a valid callbacks object.
send_callback may be NULL to unset; if set, must conform to contract documented for nghttp2_send_callback (return counts, NGHTTP2_ERR_WOULDBLOCK, etc.).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_send_callback2
functions.description: Set the primary send callback (nghttp2_send_callback2) used by nghttp2_session_send().
requirements: send_callback may be NULL to unset; if set, it must honor the documented return codes and semantics.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_recv_callback
functions.description: Set deprecated recv callback (nghttp2_recv_callback). Prefer the v2 variant. Used by nghttp2_session_recv() when not using mem_recv().
requirements: recv_callback may be NULL; if set, it must honor return semantics (bytes read, NGHTTP2_ERR_WOULDBLOCK, NGHTTP2_ERR_EOF, etc.).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_recv_callback2
functions.description: Set the primary recv callback (nghttp2_recv_callback2) used by nghttp2_session_recv().
requirements: recv_callback may be NULL; if set, it must follow documented return codes.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_frame_recv_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when a complete frame is received (excluding CONTINUATION).
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return 0 on success; nonzero is treated as fatal (NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_invalid_frame_recv_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when an invalid non-DATA frame is received and interpreted as invalid by the library; library will submit RST_STREAM or GOAWAY automatically.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return 0; nonzero treated as fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_data_chunk_recv_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when a DATA chunk is received.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return 0 on success; may return NGHTTP2_ERR_PAUSE for mem_recv2 cases; nonzero treated as fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_before_frame_send_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked just before a non-DATA frame is sent; can cancel transmission by returning NGHTTP2_ERR_CANCEL.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return 0, NGHTTP2_ERR_CANCEL, or NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE on fatal; other nonzero treated as failure.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_frame_send_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked after a frame is sent.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set must return 0; nonzero treated as fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_frame_not_send_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when a non-DATA frame was not sent due to an error; receives library error code.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set must return 0; nonzero treated as fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_stream_close_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when a stream is closed; supplies stream_id and error_code.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return 0; nonzero treated as fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_begin_headers_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when the reception of a HEADERS or PUSH_PROMISE block starts.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return 0 or documented error values (TEMPORAL/CALLBACK_FAILURE).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_header_callback
functions.description: Set header callback (name/value as byte pointers). If both v1 and v2 header callbacks are set, the v2 one takes precedence.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; must return 0 on success; may return NGHTTP2_ERR_PAUSE or NGHTTP2_ERR_TEMPORAL_CALLBACK_FAILURE; other nonzero treated as fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_header_callback2
functions.description: Set header callback variant delivering nghttp2_rcbuf-managed name/value.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; must return 0 on success or documented codes.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_invalid_header_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when an invalid regular header (not pseudo) is received (byte-pointer variant).
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, may return 0 to ignore, or NGHTTP2_ERR_TEMPORAL_CALLBACK_FAILURE to reset stream; otherwise fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_invalid_header_callback2
functions.description: Set callback invoked when an invalid regular header is received (rcbuf variant).
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, may return 0 or NGHTTP2_ERR_TEMPORAL_CALLBACK_FAILURE; others fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_select_padding_callback
functions.description: Set deprecated padding selection callback. Prefer the v2 variant.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return a payload length in [frame->hd.length, max_payloadlen] or NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_select_padding_callback2
functions.description: Set padding selection callback (v2) to decide total payload length including padding.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return value within allowed range or NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_data_source_read_length_callback
functions.description: Set deprecated callback to limit bytes requested from the DATA source read callback. Prefer v2 variant.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return length in [1, min(session/stream window, remote max frame size)] or NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_data_source_read_length_callback2
functions.description: Set v2 callback to limit bytes requested from the DATA source read callback.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return a length in the documented range or NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_begin_frame_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when a frame header is received (including CONTINUATION).
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return 0; nonzero is fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_send_data_callback
functions.description: Set callback used when NGHTTP2_DATA_FLAG_NO_COPY is used to send a complete DATA frame directly by the application.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must follow contract to send full DATA frame and return 0 or specified error codes.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_pack_extension_callback
functions.description: Set deprecated callback to pack extension frame payload into wire format. Prefer v2 variant.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must write payload bytes to provided buffer and return number of bytes; handle NGHTTP2_ERR_CANCEL/CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_pack_extension_callback2
functions.description: Set callback to pack extension frame payload (v2).
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, must return number of bytes written; may return NGHTTP2_ERR_CANCEL or NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_unpack_extension_callback
functions.description: Set callback to unpack extension frame payload from wire format into an application object available via frame->ext.payload.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, may store a pointer via *payload and must return 0 on success; may return NGHTTP2_ERR_CANCEL or NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_on_extension_chunk_recv_callback
functions.description: Set callback invoked when a chunk of an extension frame payload is received.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, return 0 on success; NGHTTP2_ERR_CANCEL to abort; NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE on fatal.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_error_callback
functions.description: Set deprecated error logging callback (message only). If both v1 and v2 are set, v2 takes precedence.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, normally return 0; returning nonzero is treated as NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_error_callback2
functions.description: Set error logging callback (code and message).
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set return 0 normally; nonzero treated as NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_callbacks_set_rand_callback
functions.description: Set callback to provide unpredictable random bytes; recommended to harden runtime behavior.
requirements: Callback may be NULL; if set, it must fill dest with destlen random bytes.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_new
functions.description: Allocate and initialize an nghttp2_option object with defaults.
requirements: option_ptr must be non-NULL to receive the pointer.
Check return value: 0 on success; NGHTTP2_ERR_NOMEM on OOM.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_del
functions.description: Free an nghttp2_option object. No-op if option is NULL.
requirements: option must be a pointer returned by nghttp2_option_new() or NULL.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_no_auto_window_update
functions.description: Disable automatic WINDOW_UPDATE transmission by the library when receiving DATA (connection and streams). When enabled, application must call consume APIs.
requirements: Set val nonzero to disable auto updates. When disabled, application must call nghttp2_session_consume()/... to advance windows; do not use nghttp2_submit_window_update for this purpose per docs.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_peer_max_concurrent_streams
functions.description: Set initial peer’s SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS value as if received, to avoid flooding peers before initial SETTINGS arrives.
requirements: val is a limit; will be overwritten by actual peer SETTINGS when received.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_no_recv_client_magic
functions.description: Server-side option: if nonzero, do not automatically handle/check client preface (24-byte magic); application must handle it. If zero (default), invalid magic triggers NGHTTP2_ERR_BAD_CLIENT_MAGIC.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_no_http_messaging
functions.description: Disable HTTP/1.1 messaging validation rules (subset) to use nghttp2 for non-HTTP uses. Client/server model limitations still apply.
requirements: Set val nonzero to disable validation.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_max_reserved_remote_streams
functions.description: Set maximum number of incoming reserved (remote) streams (client side only) to mitigate memory exhaustion by PUSH_PROMISE flood. Default 200.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_user_recv_extension_type
functions.description: Register an extension frame type (> 0x9) that the application will receive via user-defined callbacks for unpacking.
requirements: type must be strictly greater than 0x9; otherwise call does nothing.
May be called multiple times for multiple types.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_builtin_recv_extension_type
functions.description: Register an extension frame type (> 0x9) to be handled by builtin handler. If also set via user handler, the user handler takes precedence.
requirements: type must be strictly greater than 0x9; otherwise call does nothing.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_no_auto_ping_ack
functions.description: Disable automatic ACK of inbound PING frames. If set, application must send ACK via nghttp2_submit_ping() with NGHTTP2_FLAG_ACK when desired.
requirements: If enabled, application should actively ACK PINGs as appropriate.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_max_send_header_block_length
functions.description: Set maximum allowed encoded header block length to send (default 64KiB). Exceeding this during send fails with NGHTTP2_ERR_FRAME_SIZE_ERROR.
requirements: val is a size limit applied to header compression bound before sending.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_max_deflate_dynamic_table_size
functions.description: Set maximum dynamic table size for header deflation (default 4KiB). Actual max is min(peer-advertised, this value).

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_no_closed_streams
functions.description: Deprecated: Closed streams are no longer retained. Setting has no effect.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_max_outbound_ack
functions.description: Set maximum number of retained outgoing SETTINGS ACK and PING ACK frames before considering peer misbehaving and closing session. Default 1000.
requirements: val should be a reasonable limit to avoid false positives.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_max_settings
functions.description: Set maximum number of SETTINGS entries per SETTINGS frame accepted. Default 32.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_server_fallback_rfc7540_priorities
functions.description: Deprecated: RFC 7540 priorities removed. No effect on session.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_no_rfc9113_leading_and_trailing_ws_validation
functions.description: Disable RFC 9113 leading/trailing whitespace validation for HTTP header values (strict checks on important fields still apply).

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_stream_reset_rate_limit
functions.description: Set server-side token-bucket rate limit for incoming RST_STREAM handling. burst is initial/max tokens; rate is regenerated tokens per second. Defaults: burst=1000, rate=33.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_max_continuations
functions.description: Set maximum number of CONTINUATION frames following a HEADERS frame before treating peer as misbehaving and closing session. Default 8.

functions.name: nghttp2_option_set_glitch_rate_limit
functions.description: Set token-bucket rate limit for suspicious activities (“glitches”). On exhaustion, GOAWAY is sent. Defaults: burst=1000, rate=33.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_client_new
functions.description: Create a client-side HTTP/2 session using provided callbacks and user_data. Copies callbacks; does not retain pointer.
requirements: callbacks must specify at least send_callback2; if using nghttp2_session_recv(), a recv callback must be provided (deprecated v1 variant mentioned in docs).
On failure, *session_ptr is unchanged; returns 0 or NGHTTP2_ERR_NOMEM.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_server_new
functions.description: Create a server-side HTTP/2 session using provided callbacks and user_data. Copies callbacks; does not retain pointer.
requirements: callbacks must specify at least send_callback2; if using nghttp2_session_recv(), a recv callback must be provided.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_client_new2
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_client_new2(nghttp2_session **session_ptr, const nghttp2_session_callbacks *callbacks, void *user_data, const nghttp2_option *option);
functions.description: Create a client session with additional options (option may be NULL). Options are not owned nor referenced after return.
requirements: option can be NULL; if non-NULL must be an nghttp2_option created object and may be freed after return.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_server_new2
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_server_new2(nghttp2_session **session_ptr, const nghttp2_session_callbacks *callbacks, void *user_data, const nghttp2_option *option);
functions.description: Create a server session with options (option may be NULL).
requirements: option lifetime not retained past return.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_client_new3
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_client_new3(nghttp2_session **session_ptr, const nghttp2_session_callbacks *callbacks, void *user_data, const nghttp2_option *option, nghttp2_mem *mem);
functions.description: Create a client session with options and custom memory allocator (mem may be NULL to use defaults).
requirements: option and mem are not owned and not referenced after return; may be NULL.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_server_new3
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_server_new3(nghttp2_session **session_ptr, const nghttp2_session_callbacks *callbacks, void *user_data, const nghttp2_option *option, nghttp2_mem *mem);
functions.description: Create a server session with options and custom memory allocator (mem may be NULL).
requirements: option and mem may be NULL; not retained.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_del
functions.description: Free a session and all associated resources. No-op if session is NULL.
requirements: session must be a valid session pointer or NULL.
Do not use the session after deletion.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_send
functions.description: Send pending frames by repeatedly invoking the send callback. Processes outbound queue and invokes various send-related callbacks.
requirements: session must be valid and configured with send_callback2 (unless using mem_send2() elsewhere).
Returns 0 on success or NGHTTP2_ERR_NOMEM/NGHTTP2_ERR_CALLBACK_FAILURE; caller must check return value.
Application’s send callback must handle NGHTTP2_ERR_WOULDBLOCK properly.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_mem_send
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of mem_send2(). Serialize pending frames into a memory buffer and return its pointer/length without calling send callback.
requirements: data_ptr must be non-NULL to receive pointer valid until the next send/mem_send call.
Caller must transmit all returned bytes before next call.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_mem_send2
functions.description: Serialize pending frames into a memory buffer and return a pointer/length. Use when you want to handle I/O yourself.
requirements: data_ptr must be non-NULL; returned pointer valid until next mem_send2() or session_send().
Caller must send all bytes before requesting next chunk.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_recv
functions.description: Receive and process as many frames as possible using the recv callback, invoking appropriate receive-side callbacks.
requirements: session must be valid and configured with recv_callback2 unless using mem_recv2().

functions.name: nghttp2_session_mem_recv
functions.signature: ssize_t nghttp2_session_mem_recv(nghttp2_session *session, const uint8_t *in, size_t inlen);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of mem_recv2(). Process input bytes from memory (not via recv callback). May return early with NGHTTP2_ERR_PAUSE consumption count semantics.
requirements: in and inlen specify the input buffer; in must remain valid during call.
Returns number of processed bytes or negative errors as documented.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_mem_recv2
functions.signature: nghttp2_ssize nghttp2_session_mem_recv2(nghttp2_session *session, const uint8_t *in, size_t inlen);
functions.description: Process input bytes from memory (not via recv callback). Invokes receive-side callbacks. Supports NGHTTP2_ERR_PAUSE semantics.
requirements: in/inlen specify buffer; must remain valid during call.
Returns processed byte count or negative error code as documented.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_resume_data
functions.description: Re-queue a previously deferred DATA frame for the given stream back to the outbound queue.
requirements: stream_id must refer to an existing stream with deferred DATA; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_want_read
functions.description: Return nonzero if the session desires to read more data from peer.
requirements: If both want_read and want_write are 0, application should close the connection.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_want_write
functions.description: Return nonzero if the session has data to write to the peer.
requirements: If both want_read and want_write are 0, application should close the connection.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_stream_user_data
functions.description: Return the per-stream user_data associated with stream_id, or NULL if not set or stream not found.
requirements: stream_id must be an existing stream; returns NULL otherwise or if not set.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_set_stream_user_data
functions.description: Associate arbitrary user_data pointer with an existing stream (including reserved by PUSH_PROMISE). Replaces any existing value.
requirements: stream_id must refer to an existing stream; otherwise returns NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_set_user_data
functions.description: Replace the session’s user_data pointer with a new value.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_outbound_queue_size
functions.description: Return the number of frames currently queued for sending (excluding deferred DATA).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_stream_effective_recv_data_length
functions.description: Return the number of received DATA bytes for stream_id that have not yet triggered WINDOW_UPDATE, adjusted for window size changes. Returns -1 on failure.
requirements: stream_id must refer to a stream.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_stream_effective_local_window_size
functions.description: Return effective local (receive) window size for the stream, accounting for WINDOW_UPDATE adjustments. Does not include already received data. Returns -1 on failure.
requirements: stream_id must refer to a stream.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_stream_local_window_size
functions.description: Return the amount of flow-controlled payload the remote endpoint can still send on the stream before a stream-level WINDOW_UPDATE is needed. Returns -1 on failure.
requirements: stream_id must refer to a stream.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_effective_recv_data_length
functions.description: Return the number of received DATA bytes for the connection that have not yet triggered connection-level WINDOW_UPDATE, adjusted for window size changes. Returns -1 on failure.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_effective_local_window_size
functions.description: Return effective local (receive) window size for the connection, accounting for WINDOW_UPDATE adjustments. Returns -1 on failure.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_local_window_size
functions.description: Return the amount of flow-controlled payload the remote endpoint can send at connection level before a WINDOW_UPDATE is needed. Returns -1 on failure.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_stream_remote_window_size
functions.description: Return the current remote (send) window size for a stream (how much local endpoint can send without stream-level WINDOW_UPDATE). Returns -1 on failure.
requirements: stream_id must refer to a stream.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_remote_window_size
functions.description: Return the current remote (send) window size for the connection (how much local endpoint can send without connection-level WINDOW_UPDATE). Always succeeds.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_stream_local_close
functions.description: Return 1 if local peer half-closed the given stream; 0 if not; -1 if stream not found.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_stream_remote_close
functions.description: Return 1 if remote peer half-closed the given stream; 0 if not; -1 if stream not found.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_hd_inflate_dynamic_table_size
functions.description: Return current HPACK inflater dynamic table size including 32-byte per-entry overhead.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_hd_deflate_dynamic_table_size
functions.description: Return current HPACK deflater dynamic table size including 32-byte per-entry overhead.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_terminate_session
functions.description: Queue a GOAWAY to terminate the connection with given HTTP/2 error code. Last-stream-id is chosen by library based on most recently processed and previously sent values.
requirements: After transmission, want_read and want_write will become 0.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_terminate_session2
functions.description: Queue a GOAWAY to terminate the connection specifying a last_stream_id (min with previously sent). Validates parity based on client/server role.
requirements: last_stream_id must be peer-initiated ID or 0 (even for client, odd for server) and not increasing previous; else NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_shutdown_notice
functions.description: Server-only: send a GOAWAY indicating graceful shutdown (with last_stream_id set to (1u<<31)-1). Does not close streams; application should follow up with a later GOAWAY.
requirements: Must be a server-side session; client sessions return NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.
Does nothing if GOAWAY was already sent.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_remote_settings
functions.description: Return the value of a remote endpoint SETTINGS parameter (last notified).
requirements: id must be a valid nghttp2_settings_id.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_local_settings
functions.description: Return the value of a local SETTINGS parameter as acknowledged by the remote endpoint.
requirements: id must be a valid nghttp2_settings_id.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_set_next_stream_id
functions.description: Override the next outbound stream ID. Must be >= current next and have correct parity for role.
requirements: next_stream_id must be >= nghttp2_session_get_next_stream_id() and must have correct parity (even for client, odd for server); otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_next_stream_id
functions.description: Return the next outgoing stream ID (uint32_t). Returns 1<<31 when IDs are exhausted.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_consume
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_consume(nghttp2_session *session, int32_t stream_id, size_t size);
functions.description: Inform library that size bytes were consumed by the application on stream_id, allowing WINDOW_UPDATE generation (both connection and stream). Intended for use when auto window update is disabled.
requirements: stream_id must be nonzero; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.
Auto window update must be disabled via option; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_consume_connection
functions.description: Inform library that size bytes were consumed at the connection level only (affects connection WINDOW_UPDATE). For no-auto-window-update mode.
requirements: Auto window update must be disabled; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_consume_stream
functions.description: Inform library that size bytes were consumed for a specific stream only (affects stream WINDOW_UPDATE). For no-auto-window-update mode.
requirements: stream_id must be nonzero; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.
Auto window update must be disabled; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_change_stream_priority
functions.description: Deprecated: RFC 7540 priorities deprecated. No-op; always returns 0.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_create_idle_stream
functions.description: Deprecated: RFC 7540 priorities deprecated. No-op; always returns 0.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_upgrade
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_upgrade(nghttp2_session *session, const uint8_t *settings_payload, size_t settings_payloadlen, void *stream_user_data);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of upgrade2(). Post-process HTTP/1.1 Upgrade to HTTP/2. Client: submit SETTINGS from decoded HTTP2-Settings payload and open stream 1 with stream_user_data (half-closed local). Server: treat payload as received SETTINGS and open stream 1 (half-closed remote).
requirements: settings_payload must be decoded (base64url-decoding is application’s responsibility).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_upgrade2
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_upgrade2(nghttp2_session *session, const uint8_t *settings_payload, size_t settings_payloadlen, int head_request, void *stream_user_data);
functions.description: Post-process HTTP/1.1 Upgrade with explicit indication whether the request method was HEAD (head_request!=0). Semantics otherwise match upgrade().
requirements: head_request nonzero when original request was HEAD to validate response body length rules.

functions.name: nghttp2_pack_settings_payload
functions.signature: ssize_t nghttp2_pack_settings_payload(uint8_t *buf, size_t buflen, const nghttp2_settings_entry *iv, size_t niv);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of pack_settings_payload2(). Serialize SETTINGS entries into wire payload for HTTP2-Settings header (not base64url-encoded). Requires 6*niv bytes.
requirements: buf must have capacity at least 6*niv bytes; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INSUFF_BUFSIZE.
iv must not contain duplicates or invalid values; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.
Returns number of bytes written or negative error.

functions.name: nghttp2_pack_settings_payload2
functions.signature: nghttp2_ssize nghttp2_pack_settings_payload2(uint8_t *buf, size_t buflen, const nghttp2_settings_entry *iv, size_t niv);
functions.description: Serialize SETTINGS entries into wire payload for HTTP2-Settings header (not base64url-encoded). Requires 6*niv bytes.
requirements: buf must have capacity at least 6*niv; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INSUFF_BUFSIZE.
iv must not contain duplicates/invalid values; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_strerror
functions.description: Return a human-readable string for a lib error code (nghttp2_error).
requirements: lib_error_code must be one of nghttp2_error values.

functions.name: nghttp2_http2_strerror
functions.description: Return a string representation of an HTTP/2 error code (e.g., PROTOCOL_ERROR). Returns "unknown" for unknown codes.
requirements: error_code is a 32-bit HTTP/2 error code.

functions.name: nghttp2_priority_spec_init
functions.signature: void nghttp2_priority_spec_init(nghttp2_priority_spec *pri_spec, int32_t stream_id, int32_t weight, int exclusive);
functions.description: Deprecated: Initialize a priority spec (stream dependency).

functions.name: nghttp2_priority_spec_default_init
functions.description: Deprecated: Initialize priority spec with defaults (stream_id=0, weight=NGHTTP2_DEFAULT_WEIGHT, exclusive=0).

functions.name: nghttp2_priority_spec_check_default
functions.description: Deprecated: Return nonzero if pri_spec has default values.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_request
functions.signature: int32_t nghttp2_submit_request(nghttp2_session *session, const nghttp2_priority_spec *pri_spec, const nghttp2_nv *nva, size_t nvlen, const nghttp2_data_provider *data_prd, void *stream_user_data);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of submit_request2(). Submit a request HEADERS (opening a stream) and optional DATA via provider. Copies headers; lower-cases names; application must include required pseudo-headers.
requirements: session must be a client session; returns NGHTTP2_ERR_PROTO on server.
nva/nvlen must include required pseudo-headers (e.g., :method, :path, :scheme, :authority) and place pseudo before regular headers.
If data_prd is non-NULL, method must allow a body; provider callbacks must obey contracts.
Returns new stream ID or negative error (NOMEM, STREAM_ID_NOT_AVAILABLE, PROTO).
Do not submit additional frames to this new stream until before_frame_send_callback fires.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_request2
functions.signature: int32_t nghttp2_submit_request2(nghttp2_session *session, const nghttp2_priority_spec *pri_spec, const nghttp2_nv *nva, size_t nvlen, const nghttp2_data_provider2 *data_prd, void *stream_user_data);
functions.description: Submit a request HEADERS and optional DATA using provider2. Same semantics as submit_request() but newer types.
requirements: session must be a client session.
Headers must include required pseudo-headers and be valid per HTTP/2/validation settings.
If data_prd is non-NULL, its read_callback2 must follow contract.
Returns stream ID or error as documented.
Do not submit to the new stream until before_frame_send_callback.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_response
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_response(nghttp2_session *session, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_nv *nva, size_t nvlen, const nghttp2_data_provider *data_prd);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of submit_response2(). Submit response HEADERS and optional DATA for an existing stream. Copies headers; lower-cases names. Sets END_STREAM if no data.
requirements: session must be a server session; returns NGHTTP2_ERR_PROTO on client.
stream_id must be nonzero and refer to an open/reserved stream.
Do not call twice for same stream (can crash per warning); NGHTTP2_ERR_DATA_EXIST if data/headers already pending.
Returns 0 or negative errors (NOMEM, INVALID_ARGUMENT, DATA_EXIST, PROTO).

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_response2
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_response2(nghttp2_session *session, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_nv *nva, size_t nvlen, const nghttp2_data_provider2 *data_prd);
functions.description: Submit response HEADERS and optional DATA using provider2. Same semantics as submit_response().
requirements: session must be a server session.
stream_id must be nonzero; valid and appropriate state.
Only call once per response; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_DATA_EXIST or crash risk noted.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_trailer
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_trailer(nghttp2_session *session, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_nv *nva, size_t nvlen);
functions.description: Submit trailer HEADERS for an existing stream. Pseudo-headers must not be included. Often used after DATA when NO_END_STREAM was set in data read callback.
requirements: stream_id must be nonzero, or -1 special case returns 0 per docs (but typical usage is existing stream).
nva must contain only regular headers (no pseudo).
Headers copied; maintain references if NO_COPY flags used until send/not-send callback.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_headers
functions.signature: int32_t nghttp2_submit_headers(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_priority_spec *pri_spec, const nghttp2_nv *nva, size_t nvlen, void *stream_user_data);
functions.description: Low-level submit of a HEADERS frame. If stream_id == -1, opens a new stream (request) and returns its ID; otherwise acts on existing stream. Flags may include NGHTTP2_FLAG_END_STREAM.
requirements: session must be valid; if opening a request (stream_id == -1), must be a client session; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_PROTO.
stream_id must be nonzero when not opening; NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT if 0.
Headers must include required pseudo-headers for requests/responses and be valid.
Only one DATA/HEADERS in flight per stream; NGHTTP2_ERR_DATA_EXIST if violated.
Returns new stream ID (when stream_id == -1) or 0 on success; negative error on failure.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_data
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_data(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_data_provider *data_prd);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of submit_data2(). Submit one or more DATA frames for a stream using a data provider. Optionally set END_STREAM via flags.
requirements: stream_id must be nonzero and refer to open stream; else INVALID_ARGUMENT/STREAM_CLOSED.
Only one DATA/HEADERS in flight per stream; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_DATA_EXIST.
Provider must follow read callback contract.
Returns 0 or errors (NOMEM, DATA_EXIST, INVALID_ARGUMENT, STREAM_CLOSED).

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_data2
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_data2(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_data_provider2 *data_prd);
functions.description: Submit one or more DATA frames for a stream using provider2. Same semantics as submit_data().
requirements: One DATA/HEADERS in flight restriction applies.
Provider2 read callback must follow contract.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_priority
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_priority(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_priority_spec *pri_spec);
functions.description: Deprecated: RFC 7540 priorities deprecated. No-op; always returns 0.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_rst_stream
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_rst_stream(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, uint32_t error_code);
functions.description: Submit RST_STREAM to cancel/reject a stream with given HTTP/2 error code. flags currently ignored.
requirements: stream_id must be nonzero; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_settings
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_settings(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, const nghttp2_settings_entry *iv, size_t niv);
functions.description: Store local settings and submit a SETTINGS frame with the given entries. ACK frames are handled automatically by the library.
requirements: iv/niv must specify valid settings values; invalid initial window size etc. results in NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.
flags currently ignored and should be NGHTTP2_FLAG_NONE.
May trigger RST_STREAM if per-stream window exceeds max while applying.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_push_promise
functions.signature: int32_t nghttp2_submit_push_promise(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_nv *nva, size_t nvlen, void *promised_stream_user_data);
functions.description: Server-only: submit a PUSH_PROMISE on a client-initiated stream to reserve a promised stream. Returns promised stream ID.
requirements: session must be a server session; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_PROTO.
stream_id must be a client-initiated stream ID and valid/open; must be nonzero; else NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT/STREAM_CLOSED.
Headers must include required pseudo-headers for a request.
Returns promised stream ID or errors (NOMEM, PROTO, STREAM_ID_NOT_AVAILABLE, INVALID_ARGUMENT, STREAM_CLOSED).

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_ping
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_ping(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, const uint8_t *opaque_data);
functions.description: Submit a PING frame. If ACK flag is set, it responds to a received PING; otherwise sends a regular PING. If opaque_data is NULL, zeroed 8 bytes are used.
requirements: flags may include NGHTTP2_FLAG_ACK; typically NGHTTP2_FLAG_NONE unless auto-ack disabled.
opaque_data, if non-NULL, must point to 8 bytes.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_goaway
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_goaway(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t last_stream_id, uint32_t error_code, const uint8_t *opaque_data, size_t opaque_data_len);
functions.description: Submit a GOAWAY with given last_stream_id and error_code, optionally with debug opaque data (copied). After sending, new incoming streams above last_stream_id are ignored and session will become idle once active streams complete.
requirements: last_stream_id must be peer’s stream ID parity or 0; library clamps to min with previously sent.
opaque_data_len must not be too large; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_last_proc_stream_id
functions.description: Return the stream ID of the most recently processed inbound frame (suitable as last_stream_id for GOAWAY/terminate_session2).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_check_request_allowed
functions.description: Return nonzero if a new outgoing request is allowed in this session (e.g., not server, IDs available, no GOAWAY constraints).

functions.name: nghttp2_session_check_server_session
functions.description: Return nonzero if the session is a server-side session.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_window_update
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_window_update(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, int32_t window_size_increment);
functions.description: Submit WINDOW_UPDATE. Positive increments increase window (and may adjust local window size accounting); negative values decrease the local window size. stream_id==0 targets connection. 0 increment is a no-op.
requirements: Ensure resulting local window size does not overflow or go negative; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_FLOW_CONTROL.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_set_local_window_size
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_set_local_window_size(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, int32_t window_size);
functions.description: Set the absolute local window size for a stream (or 0 for connection). May submit WINDOW_UPDATE to increase window. Does not affect received-bytes counters.
requirements: stream_id must be >= 0; negative yields NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_extension
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_extension(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t type, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, void *payload);
functions.description: Submit an extension frame of a custom type (> 0x9). Application owns payload pointer and must set a pack_extension_callback2 to serialize it.
requirements: nghttp2_pack_extension_callback2 must be set; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.
Caller must keep payload memory alive until send/not-send callback indicates completion.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_altsvc
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_altsvc(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, const uint8_t *origin, size_t origin_len, const uint8_t *field_value, size_t field_value_len);
functions.description: Server-only: submit ALTSVC extension frame (RFC 7838). For connection-level (stream_id==0) origin must be provided; for stream-specific (nonzero stream_id) origin_len must be 0.
requirements: session must be valid and server-side; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.
Sum of origin_len and field_value_len must be <= 16382; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.
Origin presence rules: when stream_id==0, origin_len>0; when stream_id!=0, origin_len==0.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_origin
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_origin(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, const nghttp2_origin_entry *ov, size_t nov);
functions.description: Server-only: submit ORIGIN extension frame (RFC 8336). Copies origin entries.
requirements: session must be valid and server-side; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.
ov/nov must describe a reasonable number/size of origins; too many or too large yields NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_submit_priority_update
functions.signature: int nghttp2_submit_priority_update(nghttp2_session *session, uint8_t flags, int32_t stream_id, const uint8_t *field_value, size_t field_value_len);
functions.description: Client-only: submit PRIORITY_UPDATE frame per RFC 9218. No-op if remote has not indicated NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES=1 (i.e., if it’s 0 or omitted).
requirements: session must be client-side; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.
stream_id must be nonzero; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_change_extpri_stream_priority
functions.signature: int nghttp2_session_change_extpri_stream_priority(nghttp2_session *session, int32_t stream_id, const nghttp2_extpri *extpri, int ignore_client_signal);
functions.description: Server: change a stream’s :rfc:9218 extensible priority. If ignore_client_signal!=0, server starts ignoring client priority signals for this stream. Does nothing if NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES setting not submitted (returns 0).
requirements: session must be server-side; client returns NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.
stream_id must be nonzero and refer to an existing stream; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.
If extpri->urgency is out of bounds, it is clamped to NGHTTP2_EXTPRI_URGENCY_LOW.

functions.name: nghttp2_session_get_extpri_stream_priority
functions.description: Server: store current extensible priority of stream_id into *extpri. Does nothing (returns 0) if NO_RFC7540_PRIORITIES not submitted.
requirements: session must be server-side; client returns NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_STATE.
stream_id must be nonzero and refer to an existing stream; otherwise NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT.
extpri must be a valid pointer to receive the priority.

functions.name: nghttp2_extpri_parse_priority
functions.description: Parse a Priority header field value (RFC 9218) into extpri. Only fields successfully parsed are overwritten; extpri is not fully initialized.
requirements: value/len must point to the raw Priority field value. Returns 0 on success or NGHTTP2_ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT on parse failure.

functions.name: nghttp2_nv_compare_name
functions.description: Compare header names of two nghttp2_nv entries lexicographically. Negative/positive/zero as per strcmp-like semantics.
requirements: lhs and rhs must be valid pointers; their name and namelen fields must be initialized.

functions.name: nghttp2_select_next_protocol
functions.signature: int nghttp2_select_next_protocol(unsigned char **out, unsigned char *outlen, const unsigned char *in, unsigned int inlen);
functions.description: Deprecated in favor of nghttp2_select_alpn(). Server-side ALPN selection helper scanning client-offered protocols. Returns 1 if h2 selected, 0 if http/1.1 selected, -1 if no overlap.
requirements: out and outlen must be valid pointers to receive selected protocol (points into internal constants).

functions.name: nghttp2_select_alpn
functions.signature: int nghttp2_select_alpn(const unsigned char **out, unsigned char *outlen, const unsigned char *in, unsigned int inlen);
functions.description: Server-side ALPN selection helper. Same semantics as nghttp2_select_next_protocol() but preferred API. Returns 1 for h2, 0 for http/1.1, -1 for no overlap.
requirements: out and outlen must be valid pointers to receive selected protocol pointer/length.

functions.name: nghttp2_version
functions.description: Return pointer to a static nghttp2_info struct describing library version. If least_version (24-bit packed) is greater than the library’s version, returns NULL.
requirements: least_version is a 24-bit packed version (0xMMmmpp) or 0 to skip check.
Returned pointer must not be freed; valid for process lifetime.

functions.name: nghttp2_is_fatal
functions.description: Return nonzero if a given nghttp2_error code is fatal, indicating the session must be abandoned and only deletion is allowed.
requirements: lib_error_code must be a value from nghttp2_error.

functions.name: nghttp2_check_header_name
functions.description: Return nonzero if header field name is valid per RFC 7230 §3.2 and HTTP/2 rules (lowercase only).
requirements: name/len must point to the header name bytes.

functions.name: nghttp2_check_header_value
functions.description: Return nonzero if header field value is valid per RFC 7230 §3.2. Considered obsolete; prefer nghttp2_check_header_value_rfc9113().
requirements: value/len must point to the header value bytes.

functions.name: nghttp2_check_header_value_rfc9113

data_types.description: Raw HTTP/2 wire-format bytes as they would appear on the connection, including 9-byte frame headers followed by frame payloads. May be any sequence of frames (DATA, HEADERS, SETTINGS, etc.), possibly fragmented or concatenated.
Serialized SETTINGS frame payload in HTTP/2 wire format (not base64url-encoded). Consists of zero or more 6-byte entries: 16-bit identifier followed by 32-bit value in network byte order.

A header field name per HTTP/2 rules: lowercase token characters only (letters, digits, and hyphen), no spaces or uppercase.
An HTTP header field value as octets/text per RFC 7230/9113 constraints. May include visible ASCII, optional obs-text depending on check variant; no CR/LF within value except as allowed by spec.

Authority component suitable for the :authority pseudo-header or Host header. Typically host[:port], using characters allowed by RFC 3986 (reg-name or IPv6 literal in brackets) without spaces.
